persona: In-process quality inspector at an auto component plant moving to a full QC inspector role
resumeText:
Karthik Subramanian | Chennai | karthik.s@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Quality Inspector (IPQC), Sriram Precision Components Pvt Ltd, Oragadam, Chennai (2022 - present)
- Carried out in-process inspection of machined shafts and housings on two CNC lines every shift.
- Measured parts using vernier caliper, micrometer, height gauge and thread gauges against the control plan.
- Checked dimensions and tolerances on engineering drawings before releasing each first-off part.
- Raised non-conformance reports for rejected lots and moved parts to the quarantine area.
- Recorded inspection results in quality records for the ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 audits.
- Checked calibration records of each gauge before use and reported overdue instruments.

Trainee Inspector, Ambattur Auto Forge, Chennai (2021 - 2022)
- Did visual checks of forged parts and filled daily rejection sheets.

SKILLS
AQL sampling, 5 Whys, Minitab, MS Excel

EDUCATION
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Central Polytechnic College, Chennai, 2021
